verdict.rationale: Extend documents versioning that gives some stability: base model releases can be pinned per processor via `baseVersion`, processors are versioned, and workflows have immutable deployed versions. A public changelog also exists. However, nothing in the pack shows versioning of the API surface itself or a documented deprecation or sunset policy, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit REST API versioning scheme (e.g. version header or path), documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, independent corroboration.
